subject: Can I change posting permissions to stan-dev?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Can I change posting permissions to stan-dev?
parts:
Hi all,

For certain topics, I think we all want to cc people outside of the mailing list and have them reply. Right now, people off the list are rejected outright.

Mind if I change the permissions so that the people on the list have the ability to post, but everyone else (including those not signed up) is moderated? If that becomes a problem with too much non-stan-dev related traffic, we can switch it back.


Daniel

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Can I change posting permissions to stan-dev?
parts:
Either way's fine with me. We can either make decisions to
kick people off and redirect them.

If you allow posting on stan-dev, you have to turn off signing
up automatically, or we'll be spammed, I think.

- Bob
